items.note: 3x3 between-subject experiment varying LLM temperature (0.1, 1.2) against a no-LLM control on RAT, AUT, and DAT, with outcome creativity measured; abstract states random assignment to task, and N is not given in the abstract.

Between-participants visual ideation experiment comparing Midjourney image generation support with a no-AI baseline; AI users produced fewer ideas with less variety and lower originality and showed more fixation; assignment method not stated.

Extends Doshi and Hauser (2024): participants write stories with or without access to persona-generated plots (1 or 5 plots versus human-only), and story diversity is measured; same study as arXiv 2504.13868, N not in abstract.
Compares divergent creativity of 9,198 humans with 215,542 LLM observations on an established creativity task; no participant receives AI help (abstract from Europe PMC).

University students solve a creative product improvement task alone, with free ChatGPT, or with guided 'think first, ChatGPT later' use, then an unassisted invention task; creativity scored on both tasks (with_ai and after_ai), assignment method not stated.

Field experiment with professional designers in logo design contests comparing AI-generated variations of exemplars with original exemplars and no exemplars; quality and originality of designs measured; N and assignment not stated in abstract (SSRN working paper).

Participants experimentally assigned to high-agency AI, low-agency AI, or human-only conditions on an alternate-uses task; idea quality and preregistered similarity-to-centroid homogenization measured; 'experimentally assigned' without saying random, N not in abstract.

36 architecture students design independently then revise with an assigned workflow (GenAI image generation versus ArchDaily precedent search); eight judges rate design performance, DiD analysis; below the 50-participant threshold.

Between-subjects experiment with 47 participants assigned to No-AI, Co-led, or AI-led LLM whiteboard brainstorming; topical diversity of problems and solutions measured alongside cognition and confidence; below the 50-participant threshold.

Abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, Europe PMC, and Springer page all failed); title suggests a four-factor experiment on design experience and image-generation alignment strategies in product ideation, possibly comparing human and model output, so the full text must confirm whether participants use AI.
